operating_notes.text: Broking client base reached 13.39 lakh accounts with DP AUA expanding to ₹1,42,703 crore in FY26.

timeline.summary: SMC Global Securities filed its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation highlighting a 23% YoY increase in Q4 revenue to ₹517 Cr.
Subhash Chand Aggarwal, Promoter, declared no new encumbrances on SMC Global Securities shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI Regulations.
SMC Global Securities reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹516.9 Cr, up 22.6% YoY, and full-year FY26 PAT of ₹103.2 Cr.
SMC Global Securities allotted 15,00,000 secured NCDs aggregating to ₹15 crore.
SMC Global Securities approved a preferential issue of 100 lakh warrants aggregating ₹106 Cr to non-promoter investors.
SMC Global Securities called an EGM for November 6, 2026, to approve a ₹106 crore preferential warrant issue to non-promoters.
